title: KnoveraQueryIntentRecord
description: Schema for Knovera Query Intent Classification dataset records (C5.2).

example_id.description: Unique identifier for the query intent record.

intent.description: The primary single intent label assigned to this query.

requires_conversation_context.description: True if resolving requires context from previous conversation turns.

requires_multi_source_evidence.description: True if resolving requires synthesizing across multiple distinct documents.

requests_explicit_citations.description: True if the query explicitly asks for citations, quotes, or page numbers.

contains_ambiguous_reference.description: True if query contains unresolved anaphora or deictic pronouns.

source_type.description: Provenance origin of the query example.

taxonomy_version.description: Taxonomy version under which this record was annotated.

split.description: Assigned evaluation split membership (train, dev, or test).

paraphrase_group_id.description: Optional group ID for keeping near-duplicate queries in the same split.
